service_binding: Priority Mail — Retail (Letters, Large Envelopes & Parcels)
Source: USPS Notice 123, effective July 12, 2026, page 5. Retail prices; bands are 'Weight Not Over (lbs.)'.

Scope per review_brief.md: zones 1-8 and 1-10 lb bands. The source also prints a Zone 9 column and bands 11-70 lb; those are excluded here (see Source_Extract). Flat-rate envelope/box prices printed at the top of page 5 are excluded: the brief specifies the sender's own ordinary rectangular carton, no USPS flat-rate packaging.
Source: USPS Notice 123, effective July 12, 2026, page 7. Retail parcel prices; ounce bands as printed, then 'Weight Not Over' pound bands (source note 9).

Scope per review_brief.md: zones 1-8, ounce bands through 15.999 oz and 1-10 lb bands. The source also prints a Zone 9 column, bands 11-70 lb and an 'Oversized' row; those are excluded here (see Source_Extract). Column B 'Key (oz)' is a derived lookup helper (band maximum in ounces), not printed in the source; the source prints pound bands as bare numbers (note 9), shown here with a 'lb' suffix.
